_readme: SYSTEM lines: the archive's machine voice. Cold, short, never funny on purpose. Shown at the top of the screen and, with sound on, spoken by a synthetic female voice. One line is picked at random per event; most file openings say nothing.
boot: Records Office terminal on. Reading room open.
Lending desk open. Files may not leave the building.
open: File out of drawer. Return after reading.
Do not write on the file.
Photocopying at the counter. Ten cents a page.
Final copy on top. Earlier versions underneath.
classified: Classified material. Read on the premises only.
Classified material. Staff present during reading.
Loan recorded against your reader's pass.
reveal: Redaction lifted for this reading only.
early: Earlier version. Not valid for reference.
wall: Links taken from the file text.
